say:0:1011308001:0.text: May I have your attention, please? Allow me to introduce with great honor—the hidden gem of Lunadorf—the Wiserherb Garden!
say:0:1011308001:0.source_cn: 向各位隆重介绍，这就是月湖村的藏宝地——叶维斯草药园！

say:1:1011308002:0.text: 50%... Wait, maybe 70%? Anyway, most of the materials I use to create my greatest inventions come from here!
say:1:1011308002:0.source_cn: 我重大发明里五成……还是是七成的原料来着？都来自这里！

say:2:1011308003:0.text: Before sourcing materials for Korin's new arms, I need to inform Uncle Dyan, the garden owner, first.
say:2:1011308003:0.source_cn: 要给科林大叔的新手臂找材料，得先和园主迪恩叔叔说一声才行。
